scope_gaps.note: The abstract names deep breathing only as one example of arousal-decreasing activities and reports a pooled effect over all of them; it gives no instruction for how to breathe or for deferring a reaction in a live dispute. The sentence says na przykład, so it does not claim more.
The abstract adds that arousal-increasing activities were heterogenous and complex; the sentence says przeciętnie, so it does not claim a uniform null effect.
